trigger_condition: Tenant GPT deployment uses a vendor prefix other than 'openai.' (e.g. 'azure.')
guard_snippet: const GPT_VENDOR_PREFIXES = ['openai.', 'azure.']; // or strip any '<token>.' prefix generically
potential_consequence: GPT family never matches; model silently dropped from VS Code/Desktop catalog

trigger_condition: Single-number Claude family (claude-opus-5/claude-sonnet-5) meets tenant's undashed dated id like ...-20260101
guard_snippet: widen RELEASE_DATE_PATTERN to also strip contiguous [-._]20\d{6} suffixes
potential_consequence: Date digits get read as the minor version, identity mismatches, model never resolves

trigger_condition: Same identity has both a vendor-prefixed undated id and a dashed dated id in the tenant catalog
guard_snippet: parse and compare the actual release date instead of raw string localeCompare
potential_consequence: pickMostRecent can pick the wrong duplicate, not the truly newest deployment

trigger_condition: Catalog contains both a '-vertex' id and a dated non-vertex id for the same preferred family
guard_snippet: exclude '-vertex' ids from the generic identity match; keep vertexId only as the explicit last-resort fallback
potential_consequence: Vertex id can outrank a better dated match via lexicographic pickMostRecent; the fallback below becomes dead code

trigger_condition: proxyUrl is malformed/not an absolute URL when fetchTenantModelCatalog runs
guard_snippet: move `new URL(...)` inside the try block so it also converts to ConfigurationError
potential_consequence: A raw TypeError escapes instead of the function's documented ConfigurationError contract

trigger_condition: Gateway returns a transient 5xx while resolving the VS Code tenant model catalog
guard_snippet: fall back like desktop.ts's fetchClaudeModels does for 5xx instead of always throwing
potential_consequence: Whole VS Code BYOK target hard-fails on a transient outage; Desktop degrades gracefully instead

trigger_condition: Tenant renames a Gemini/Qwen/Kimi deployment id (resolver only fuzzy-matches GPT and Claude)
guard_snippet: log unmatched capability-table families, or extend resolver coverage beyond GPT/Claude
potential_consequence: Model silently vanishes from the VS Code picker with no diagnostic trail

trigger_condition: modify() is called with {} formattingOptions when inserting/replacing claudeCode.* keys
guard_snippet: pass real formattingOptions (tabSize/insertSpaces/eol) derived from the file instead of {}
potential_consequence: jsonc-parser inserts/replaces the managed keys fully unformatted on one line, defeating the format-preservation goal

trigger_condition: VS_CODE_SUPPORTED_MODELS and VsCodeModelDefinition exports were removed/renamed
potential_consequence: Both integration test files fail to compile: no exported member VS_CODE_SUPPORTED_MODELS/VsCodeModelDefinition

trigger_condition: Function now requires gatewayKey and fetches /v1/llm_models before writing
guard_snippet: update tests/integration/vscode-byok.test.ts:222 to pass a gatewayKey and have its mock server serve the catalog endpoint
potential_consequence: Mock server returns {ok:true} for the new catalog call, catalog resolves empty, write throws ConfigurationError instead of succeeding

trigger_condition: Two different capability-table families resolve to the same tenant deployment id
guard_snippet: dedupe by tenantId before pushing into models, or assert uniqueness
potential_consequence: Duplicate model ids get written into chatLanguageModels.json, corrupting VS Code's model picker

trigger_condition: resolveTenantModelId returns a token-reordered/vendor-normalized id, e.g. claude-opus-5 → claude-5-opus
guard_snippet: check membership via the same identity parser instead of `resolvedName.startsWith(`${name}-`)`
potential_consequence: missingPreferredModels logs a false 'missing' entry for a family that actually resolved, defeating the diagnostic
